findings.summary: Literal projection replay is one Array.reduce with no per-event isolation; one throwing/corrupt event aborts the rebuild with no durable poison record or operator disposition.
findings.production_scope: Event-sourcing module README/ADR says the module is currently unused by production callers.

findings.summary: Live SSE callbacks launch processEvent promises without serialization; ordered checkpoint state is mutated by concurrently completing events.
Checkpoint upsert is unconditional, so a slow earlier event can overwrite a later checkpoint and regress durable state.
A later good event can commit a checkpoint beyond an earlier poison event; restart backfill then starts after the unresolved ledger and may skip the poison permanently.
Backfill resumes from lastProcessedLedger + 1, so a poison event after a successful sibling in the same ledger can be skipped by ledger-only restart semantics.
A dedup P2002 returns before checkpoint advance; an already-processed event encountered behind a stale checkpoint does not repair the resume point.
Unique key contractId+txHash+eventType can collapse two distinct same-type events emitted by one transaction; canonical event id/paging token should participate in identity.

required_invariants: No successful event may advance the durable checkpoint past an earlier unresolved event.
Checkpoint position must distinguish multiple events in the same ledger.
Poison-event disposition must be durable and explicit; skip must never be a silent log-and-continue.
A restart must surface the same unresolved poison until retry succeeds or an operator explicitly skips/quarantines it.
Distinct same-type events from one transaction must remain distinct.

recommended_scope.active_listener: Implement ordered processing/commit barrier, canonical event identity, durable dead-letter state, alerting and runbook.
recommended_scope.offchain_event_module: If maintainer confirms #912 also targets backend/src/events, replace bare reduce with event-level diagnostic/policy and poison tests; preserve ADR-011 truth that module is unused.
